intro.summary: St. Jerome, priest and Doctor of the Church, translated the Bible into Latin and is honored for his scholarship and devotion to Scripture.

blocks.text: You can pray the full St Jerome Novena below.
blocks.title: Introduction

parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. O glorious Saint Jerome, devoted servant of God and lover of Sacred Scripture, you gave your life to studying, translating, and defending the Word of God. You pursued holiness with great zeal and bore every hardship for the sake of truth. I come to you humbly, asking for your powerful intercession before our Lord Jesus Christ. As you spent your days immersed in prayer and the wisdom of God’s Word, help me to grow in love for Holy Scripture and to seek God’s truth in all things. Pray for me in my present need

that through God’s mercy and your intercession, I may receive what I ask, if it be according to His holy will. Amen. Saint Jerome, you were not afraid of difficulty, criticism, or hardship in your service to the Church. Obtain for me the courage to remain faithful, the wisdom to discern God’s will, and the perseverance to follow it. Pray that I may one day join you and all the saints in eternal life, where we will praise God forever. Amen. Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen. Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Saint Jerome, pray for us! In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
